business_problem: HTOP Hotels needed to replace spreadsheet-based workforce planning with a system that could use live hotel demand signals to coordinate staffing, meals, supplier orders, and reporting across multiple properties in real time.
solution_summary: HTOP Hotels adopted IBM Planning Analytics through IBM Business Partner Integra to centralize workforce and resource planning across its hotel chain. The platform takes booking demand from the group's hotels and turns it into proactive forecasts for staffing needs, room-cleaning capacity, meal planning, and supplier orders. Scenario-planning features let operations teams compare likely staffing outcomes and adjust quickly as tourist demand changes, replacing the previous spreadsheet process that forced several departments to coordinate manually. Because Planning Analytics continuously collects and analyzes information from the hotels in real time, HTOP can fine-tune forecasts as new reservation data arrives and expose the results through much faster reporting. The same centralized planning environment also improved coordination between decision makers, making workforce management more employee-centric while supporting the chain's service-quality goals.

solution_components.name: IBM Planning Analytics
solution_components.role: Collects booking and operational data, forecasts demand, and supports collaborative scenario planning for hotel workforce management.

data_flow: Reservation and hotel-demand data from HTOP properties flow into IBM Planning Analytics, which generates staffing and resource forecasts, lets teams evaluate scenarios, and then feeds real-time reports that guide workforce planning, supplier orders, and day-to-day hotel operations.
business_outcome: HTOP Hotels reduced planning effort, aligned staffing more closely to demand, accelerated reporting, and improved collaboration across departments responsible for hotel operations and workforce management.
